verdict.rationale: The sign-in axis applies to INPI's online filing portal, but the evidence pack never describes its sign-in method. Nothing documents credential MFA, nor rules out biometric liveness, in-person visits or mailed PINs. The probe shows only that data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests and that data access needs an account-issued token, which says nothing about how a human authenticates.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
